name: Information-based Transfer Function Fusion
aliases: Information-based Transfer Functions for Multimodal Visualization
definition: A method for multimodal volume visualization that fuses two input modalities (values and gradients) and classifies them using information theory metrics (probability, weighting, and opposite information) to create a single fused value and gradient for transfer function classification.
summary: Information-based Transfer Function Fusion automates multimodal volume visualization by fusing registered modalities into a single scalar using information theory, distinguishing itself by defining information channels between inputs and viewpoints.
